description: Open a model in the Convexity desktop app and bring the app to the front — starting the app if it is not running. Defaults to the active model. Once the app has the model open, edits made here appear in it live and solve_via_desktop_app can run it locally. With no tab connected this opens the web app in the computer's DEFAULT browser, already paired.

name.description: Web app: the model's name as the tab's Files panel shows it.

path.description: Absolute .db path. Default: the active model.

name: open_in_app
